mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_session (child_id, story_id, roadmap_id, daily_input, started_at, status) VALUES (#{childId}, #{storyId}, #{roadmapId}, #{dailyInput}, NOW(), #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT session_id , child_id , story_id , roadmap_id , daily_input , started_at , ended_at , status FROM story_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM story_session WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND CAST(started_at AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM story_session WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND CAST(started_at AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE

SELECT s.session_id , s.child_id , s.story_id , s.roadmap_id , s.daily_input , s.started_at , s.ended_at , s.status FROM story_session s WHERE s.child_id = #{childId} AND s.status = 'INCOMPLETE' AND CAST(s.started_at AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM story_node n WHERE n.story_id = s.story_id) ORDER BY s.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
